test_title: PYST 30: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: If the selling price of a bed is 2-times of initial, then the profit is 6-times of initial. Find the initial profit percentage (in %).
solution:
**Given:**

Initial SP = S

Initial CP = C

Initial Profit = S - C

New SP = 2S

New Profit = 6 × Initial Profit

**Formula used:**

New Profit = New SP - CP

Initial Profit% = (Initial Profit ÷ CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

2S - C = 6(S - C)

⇒ 2S - C = 6S - 6C

⇒ 5C = 4S

⇒ S = (5C) ÷ 4

Initial Profit = (5C ÷ 4) - C = C ÷ 4

Profit% = (C ÷ 4) ÷ C × 100

⇒ Profit% = 25%

**∴ Initial Profit% = 25%**
